description: A feedback offer waits and he says 'read it back to me': the tutor takes it as a read back, speaks the offer's exact text word for word, asks for his yes, and does not confirm.

history.q: Can this work with Olive Tree?
history.a: Lampas does not work with Olive Tree. I can pass your wish to the makers; I cannot say what they will decide.

pending_offer.text: He wants Lampas to work with the Olive Tree app.

answer.contains: He wants Lampas to work with the Olive Tree app.
